opening.campaign.description: Meet your teacher, explore town work and discover an old record. Each day offers an alternative way to grow outside class.
opening.campaign.name: The First Three Days
opening.chain.description: Meet your teacher, plan your day and explore four town facilities. Turn your first allowance and a small discovery into a memory for your room.
opening.chain.name: My School Days, Our Town
opening.clue.archive-door.result: The Archive door is locked. An old photograph near the gap shows a town that looks a little different. Its faded date is unreadable. You want to ask the librarian about it.
opening.clue.repair-ledger.result: The ledger holds old repair records. The writing beside a faded date is hard to read. This fragment does not explain what happened. You want to ask the workshop manager about the town long ago.
opening.day.1.direction: Meet your teacher and choose a Daily Plan. Library self-study is another way to begin today's growth.
opening.day.1.name: Day 1: School and a Plan
opening.day.1.next: Tomorrow, explore four facilities and choose your first work.
opening.day.2.direction: Visit the four career facilities, then earn allowance by helping at the store or workshop.
opening.day.2.name: Day 2: Explore and Earn
opening.day.2.next: Look into the library's locked door or the workshop's old ledger.
opening.day.3.direction: Find a small clue at either the Archive door or the workshop ledger.
opening.day.3.name: Day 3: Questions in Old Records
opening.day.3.next: Buy furniture with your allowance and make room for your new interests.
opening.dialogue.guide: Go meet your teacher at school. You can choose how to spend your day. Press Tab to check your next step in the Objective Journal.
opening.dialogue.librarian: The Archive is still locked. Tell me if an old photo or record makes you curious. For now, take your time with the small clues.
opening.dialogue.manager: Would you help around the workshop? Afterwards you may look through the old repair ledger. Much of the writing has faded, so read it carefully.
opening.dialogue.teacher: There are many ways to spend a day. Choose something in your Daily Plan. Exploring, helping and resting outside school help you grow too.

opening.facility.design-studio.name: Design Studio
